name: lez_maker_node
description: The Maker's Node (the swap engine) and everything it runs: the Maker Node, its CLI, its Bitcoin and Zcash actors and the LEZ v0.2 sidecar, with the launcher lez_swap_node starts it from. Variants: linux-arm64 and linux-amd64 carry the Linux executables the role's container image runs; darwin-arm64 carries the same executables built for macOS on Apple silicon (release builds, ad-hoc signed, not notarised)
